title: Massive CME event during the Older Dryas

tellings.quote: massive CME event unlike anything that we've ever seen in modern human history hit the earth

plain: Near the end of the last ice age, during a cold spell called the Older Dryas, the Earth was hit by a coronal mass ejection, a huge burst of charged material thrown off by the sun, bigger than anything in modern history. That is the claim of a researcher named Matt LaCroix, who ties it to traces in Antarctic ice cores and does not name a source. If true, a solar blast of that size would have hit the Earth hard during humanity's prehistory.
